name: GlowFormat
description: Represents a glow effect around an Office graphic.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the GlowFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the GlowFormat object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Radius
properties.description: Gets or sets the radius value of the glow effect for the GlowFormat object. Read/write.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Gets a ColorFormat object that represents the color of text formatted as glow. Read-only.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified glow as a value between 0.0 (opaque) and 1.0 (clear). Read/write.
